headline: AfD 🍆 EDGES 🗳️ toward POWER 💪 in Saxony-Anhalt just SHY 📉 of MAJORITY
text:
Germany's far-right AfD 🏛️ just COOKED 🍳 a decisive 🍆 victory 🏆 in the eastern 🧭 state of Saxony-Anhalt 🌲 far ahead 🚀 of all mainstream 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 rivals 😤!! Preliminary 📊 results 📉 show Ulrich Siegmund's crew 🧑‍🚀 snagged 43.8% 🗳️ of the vote 🗳️ crushing the conservative CDU's measly 17.2% 📉 but falling 🍂 just short of that outright majority 🍑 needed to govern solo 🚫!! Tricky negotiations 🤝 on who gets to run 🏃‍♂️ the state lie ahead 🛤️ with everyone edging 😩 closer to the climax 🥵 of this political 🍆 rail session!! "It was sensational" 😍 declared the state's charismatic 🕺 leader Ulrich Siegmund while adding his party scored a clear mandate 📜 to govern the whole damn thing 🏰!! No far-right party has controlled 🎮 a German state since World War Two 🕰️ and grabbing state level power 🔋 would hand them the keys 🔑 to policing 👮 local education 📚 and culture 🎨 all at once!!

Saxony-Anhalt's tiny population of just 2.1 million 👥 has the local AfD branch labeled by domestic intelligence 🕵️ as right-wing extremist 🏴‍☠️ a tag that 35-year-old Siegmund firmly rejects 🚫 while flashing that signature smile 😎!! He stood shoulder to shoulder 🫂 with joint national leaders Alice Weidel 👩‍💼 and Tino Chrupalla 🧔 as exit polls 📡 revealed they were on track to more than DOUBLE 📈 the party's weak 2021 result 🥉 leaving the trio absolutely overjoyed 🎉 and dripping with delight 💧!! The AfD is currently projected to grab 39 seats 🪑 in the 83-seat state parliament 🏛️ falling three seats short of that outright majority 🍑 so Ulrich Siegmund says he refuses to lead any minority government 🙅‍♂️ even if the national bosses see it as possible 🤔!! "If necessary there'll just be new elections 🗳️ then we'd just get 50 or 55%" he boasted while hinting he was prepared to work with individual MPs 🧑‍⚖️ or a willing party partner 💞!!

One idea floating around like a sneaky side piece 🍑 is whether the small left-wing populist BSW party could give tacit support 🤫 to let AfD form a minority government 🪑 without full commitment!! That BSW crew is set to win five seats 🪑 and they are also tough on migration 🛂 while backing the import of Russian gas ⛽ which lines up nicely with AfD's Russia-friendly vibes 🇷🇺!! AfD has signaled openness to talk 🗣️ with other parties but all of them apart from BSW flat out refuse to cooperate with the far-right crew 🚫 leaving Beatrix von Storch to tell the BBC 📺 her party intends to hold talks to peel away individual members of parliament 🧑‍⚖️ especially from the unhappy CDU bloc 😠!! She warned that parties continuing to ignore the vote of the people 🗳️ risk severe chaos 🌪️ and a brand new election 🗳️ which would only pump AfD numbers even higher 📈!!

Commentators and political opponents called this AfD victory a total watershed moment 🌊 and a clear break with the past ⏮️ while the main TV channel Das Erste literally cancelled its legendary crime drama Tatort 📺 just to dissect what the hell this result even means 🧐!! "This isn't just about Saxony-Anhalt" Ulrich Siegmund told his roaring supporters 🗣️ "It's a signal for the whole of Germany - a self-confident signal" 📣 that left the crowd erupting in cheers 🎉 and then bursting into the national anthem 🎶!! His opposite number in the CDU Sven Schulze conceded defeat 😔 while watching his conservative vote slump by more than half from the previous election 📉 admitting it was an extremely tough and intensive campaign 🏋️ that his party now has to deal with 🫠!! Germany's centre-left SPD labeled the outcome truly dramatic 🎭 and their national leader Lars Klingbeil called it a direct signal to Berlin 🏙️ insisting they would hear it loud and clear 📢 with turnout hitting a massive 77.8% 📈!!

AfD supporters in Magdeburg praised Ulrich Siegmund's skill at winning over voters 🗳️ with one man named Ollie saying "This man gives us what no-one else can give" 💪 while another voter Bert admitted people in the east can sense things are sliding downhill 🛬 and added "Things need to improve for us for my family - I have three children 🧒🧒🧒 I'm in fear that safety erodes more and more" 😟!! The AfD now leads national opinion polls 📊 ahead of Chancellor Friedrich Merz's conservatives and the Social Democrats but their true heartland remains in these eastern states 🧭 where they also won in neighbouring Thuringia back in 2024 yet still fell short of full power then 🛑!! Among their policies is that highly controversial remigration plan 🧳 widely seen as code for mass deportations of migrants 🚫 although the party insists it only targets criminals and those in the country illegally 🛑 and of course running just one of 16 states wouldn't let them pull it off anyway 🚧!! The party has also slammed the historic Bauhaus school of design 🏛️ calling it the dead-end of modernism 🎨 which has some critics accusing them of echoing language from the Nazis 🕵️ while anti-AfD demonstrators at a Democracy Festival warned Germany must learn from its history 📖 and never go back to the dark times 🌑!! Veteran Jewish community leader Charlotte Knobloch a 93-year-old Holocaust survivor said days like this make it hard to recognise her homeland anymore 😢 and begged mainstream parties not to just stand by during this decline 🛑!!
